scenarios.name: one press is one transaction holding the net value; its late tick stays silent
a host abort leaves zero trace and closes the press
a release without a tick is a one-shot press
a press whose leaves are empty publishes nothing
each tick replaces the leaves by position, shrinking and growing
another press captures the window: the open one leaves zero trace
a moved document reopens the press on the new revision
windows scrub independently and a freeze aborts them all
a window that left the roster retires its press
a stale abort of another press keeps the open one
an abort input drops the open press
